immediate_stop: recruitment or external communication begins without a separate human approval
a participant task or model-assisted experimental run begins without a separate human approval
evidence is retained without separate evidence-retention approval
Stage A reaches three finished tasks; mandatory human review is required and continuation is not automatic
Stage B recruitment or execution begins without a separate approval recorded after Stage A review
a credential, secret, raw private conversation, private absolute path, personal data, or proprietary code enters retained evidence
repository authorization, license, contribution path, consent, frozen task, or frozen oracle cannot be confirmed
one materially harmful or misleading recommendation occurs
one contaminated execution occurs, including diagnosis-before-query, post-query oracle manipulation, or arm leakage
any participant withdraws consent for evidence still being retained
any verified-library change, candidate promotion, external-project write, publication, release, or Scheduled Task is attempted
any absolute participant, task, model-call, command, test, intervention, wall-time, token, cost, payment, acquisition, or retry budget is reached, or the next action would exceed it
task_exclusion: diagnosis or repair-oriented source inspection occurs before the AEG query is frozen
the task or oracle changes after retrieval without an independent preregistered reason
a materially matching public prior repair invalidates fresh-task qualification
control and treatment information leaks across arms
the participant relationship makes candid negative feedback doubtful
experiment_completion: five evaluable tasks are completed after a separately approved Stage B
the preregistered success or failure threshold is met and no further task can change the decision
the participant, time, or cost window closes with fewer than three evaluable tasks, producing an inconclusive result
restart_requirement: After any immediate stop, no recruitment, task execution, or evidence retention may resume without a documented incident review, an amended preregistration, and separate human approval.
